'''Cranberry Sauce''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

One Cranberry Sauce can be purchased each year from the [[Traveling Cart|Traveling Merchant]]'s shop at the [[Festival of Ice]] for {{Price|200}}. It also may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock.  Five Cranberry Sauce may occasionally be found in a [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure room]] in the Skull Cavern. One Cranberry Sauce may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Bundles==
Cranberry Sauce is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Cranberry Sauce can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Flat Topped Hat|class=inline}}. It can be also used as a red dye color at the dye pots in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Cranberry Sauce is not used in any [[quests]].
